channel.title: Changelogs on Myriad
channel.description: Recent content in Changelogs on Myriad

item.description: This version fixes a minor pack.mcmeta issue with 1.6.3.
This version ports the pack to the Chaos Cubed drop, adding a new recipe for cinnabar, new mason trades, and a few other features.

item.title: 1.6.3 Beta 1
item.description: This beta begins the port to Chaos Cubed, adding a new recipe for cinnabar and a few other features.
This version begins the rebrand to Myriad, adds new models for baby snails and sproutlings, and ports to Tiny Takeover.
This version ports to the Mounts of Mayhem drop, while adding a few minor features in the process.

item.title: 1.6.0: Resin and Ruins
item.description: This update adds the creaking crypt, resin pottery, resin candy, as well as reworking the woodland mansion, ancient city archaeology, and much more.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 4
item.description: The fourth beta for 1.6, adding a new source of brown dye, changing some of the creaking crypt, and several other changes.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 3
item.description: The third beta for 1.6, including a new basement for the creaking crypt and a few other changes.
This version ports to the copper age drop, while also adding a few other minor features.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 2
item.description: The second beta for 1.6, tweaking existing content and adding a few new advancements and recipes.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 1
item.description: The first beta for 1.6, adding the creaking crypt, resin pottery, a new armor trim, a new banner pattern, and a full rework of the paintbrush and mansion basement.
This update adds enchantable and craftable horse armor, as well as enchanted golden carrot changes and much much more.
This update adds dyed written books, equippable lockets of learning, and updates several textures while porting to 1.21.7.
This update adds dyed compasses and several other small features and changes while porting to the new Chase the Skies drop.
This update ports the pack to the “Spring to Life” drop while adding several small related features.

item.title: 1.5.0: Pots and Plants and Potions
item.description: This version adds tons of new decor options, as well as reworking the cursed crown, gobblerift, and crashed end ship.
This minor version ports the pack to 1.21.2 and adds several minor quality of life features.

item.title: 1.4.0: Embers of the Past
item.description: The full changelog for Version 1.4, “Embers of the Past”, including new archaeology and nether content.
This somewhat small update ports the pack to 1.21 and adds four new tea types, all while fixing several high-priority issues.
This version fixes several bugs and improves the functionality of the boomerang underwater.
This minor update adds baby snails, updates everything to 1.20.5, overhauls swordfish and apple pies, and makes several other small changes.
This version includes changes to tangling pearls and wandering witches. It also fixes a major issue with prismarine pottery and several other minor issues.
This version fixes several important bugs, tweaks wandering witches and witch hats, and makes several other minor changes.
This version fixes an issue, adds loot to pots, makes minor changes, and ports to 1.20.4.

item.title: 1.3.0: Waves and Wilds
item.description: The full changelog for 1.3, the “Waves and Wilds” update, including new ocean and jungle-related content.
This version fixes two bugs, adds a new panorama, improves the archaeologist texture, and makes several other minor changes.
This version has a couple small changes and additions, along with a few bugfixes missed in the 1.2 update.

item.title: 1.2.0: Frozen in Time
item.description: The changelog for the 1.2 update, “Frozen in Time”, including plenty of new features and changes.
This small release has bugfixes. Yes, only bugfixes. This is fine.
The changelog for the minor version 1.1.1, including updates to 1.19.4 and other small changes.

item.title: 1.1.0: Souls and Structures
item.description: The changelog for the 1.1 update, “Souls and Structures”, containing tons of new content and changes.

item.title: 1.1.0 Beta 6
item.description: The changelog for 1.1 Beta 6, including many quality of life changes, fixes, and additions.

item.title: 1.1.0 Beta 5
item.description: The changelog for 1.1 beta 5, including a small number of changes and fixes.

item.title: 1.1.0 Beta 4
item.description: The fourth 1.1 beta, including the removal of rings, lots of new features, and important bugfixes.

item.title: 1.1.0 Beta 3
item.description: The changelog for the third 1.1 beta, including a woodland mansion rework and lots of quality of life changes.

item.title: 1.1.0 Beta 2
item.description: The changelog for the second beta of the 1.1 update, including a new ring type and a small amount of fixes.

item.title: 1.1.0 Beta 1
item.description: The changelog for the first 1.1 beta, including lots of new structures and intriguing new echo shard features.
This update is a small amount of hotfixes and changes, fixing a couple issues and tweaking content.

item.title: 1.0.0: The Reboot
item.description: The changelog for the massive 1.0 update. Tons of new features, tons of changes, and plenty of removals.
The changelog for the V0.5.1 update, including lots of snail features and an amazing new wiki.

item.title: 0.5.1 Beta 1
item.description: The changelog for V0.5.1 Beta 1, which includes a plethora of bug fixes and a couple new features.

item.title: 0.5.0: Caves and Waves
item.description: The changelog for the V0.5 update, Caves and Waves, including tons of ocean and underground content.

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 9
item.description: This beta may not have tons of content, but it was sorely needed to fix bugs and update content to 1.17-pre1.

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 8
item.description: This beta is rather small. However, the changes it brings are rather… explosive.

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 7
item.description: A large beta with tons of tweaks, fixes, and new content, one of the largest betas yet.

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 6
item.description: A small beta that adds a new use to beetroot alongside several bugfixes.

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 5
item.description: Mobs galore! This beta introduces both the snail and geomancer while making a few other changes.

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 4
item.description: A small beta feature-wise, with tons of optimization, fixes, and changes. Lots of good code in this one!

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 3
item.description: A very small beta including texture changes and a few minor fixes.

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 2
item.description: Our second beta has arrived, now with uses for features introduced last update, along with tons of new features. It also includes lots of code optimization!

item.title: 0.5.0 Beta 1
item.description: The changelog for the very first beta version we ever released, including updates to 1.17 and a few small new features.

item.title: 0.4.0: End and Emeralds
item.description: The massive changelog for 0.4.0, including tons of new end and illager-related features.
A small update including paintbrushes, texture reworks, and smoldering seekers
This release fixes many silly bugs and adds a small amount of features as well.

item.title: 0.3.0: Gold and Gems
item.description: The changelog for the Gold and Gems update, one of our largest updates so far!

item.title: 0.2.0: Debugging and Treehugging
item.description: A large update filled with bugfixes alongside several nature-adjacent features.

item.title: 0.1.0: A Clean Slate
item.description: The changelog for our massive restart, removing lots of features and adding a few more.

item.title: The Dark Times
item.description: The versions made eons ago with no regard for any sort of design principles.
